record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) The Expert Group shall make a recommendation within ________ months from the date of its constitution to the effect that the project shall be abandoned forthwith. (b) Any person interested in any land which has been notified under sub-section (i) of Section 11, as being required or likely to be required for a public purpose, may submit his objection within ________ days from the date of publication of preliminary notification. (c) The Requiring Body shall deposit the amount promptly so as to enable the Government to publish the declaration within a period of ________ from the date of the publication of preliminary notification. (d) The Collector shall make an award within a period of ________ months from the date of publication of declaration under Section 19. (e) In cases of urgency, whenever the Government so directs, the Collector, though no such award has been made, may, on the expiration of ________ days from the publication of the notice, take possession of any land needed for a public purpose.
